page.overview:
Who is Lightning McQueen?

Lightning McQueen is one of the main characters of the Cars franchise.

Lightning is a red race car with yellow and orange decals, the Rust-eze logo is painted on his hood, the number 95 is painted in orange or red on his doors and roof, red rims, blue eyes.

Lightning is a red racecar sponsored by Rust-eze Medicated Bumper Ointment ("With Just a Little Rust-eze, you can look like Lightning McQueen!"). Lightning's model is a 2006 hand-built stock racing car - one of a kind.

He is number 95 in the movie, and at the beginning of the movie, he is racing in the final race of the 2005 Piston Cup Series in Nashville, Tennessee. McQueen is one of the three cars in the field capable of winning the Piston Cup Championship. Winning the Piston Cup would make McQueen the first ever rookie to do so. However, when he foolishly refused a new set of tires, causing his current rear ones to blow out on the final lap despite being the lead near the end. He narrowly sticks his tongue out, making a three-way tie with the other 2 cars in contention for the Championship, Strip "The King" Weathers and Chick Hicks.
